summary: End-to-end tested the 5 fixes (multipart email, attachment support, Dennis Lein rename, empty-signature no fallback, mobile div signature). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in test_team_email_multipart.py after fixing a latent NameError bug in routes/team.py:451 (used undefined `data.subject` after JSON→Form refactor). Frontend: verified data-testid='team-add-lead-btn' in header, data-testid='team-new-lead-note' inside Add-Lead modal, data-testid='email-attachment-input' inside Email composer (opened via Send Email button on a lead detail); filename is displayed after upload and an X remove button is present.

minor.issue: 10MB oversize check raises HTTPException 400 inside an outer try/except that wraps it in a generic 500 with 'Email sending failed: 400: Attachment too large (max 10MB)'. Should re-raise HTTPException as-is so the client sees 400.
`import base64` on line 416 is unused (attachment content is sent as raw byte list). Safe to remove.

action_items: REVIEW MY FIX: /app/backend/routes/team.py line 451 — changed `{data.subject}` → `{subject}`. Before the fix every successful email send (i.e. once RESEND_API_KEY is configured in prod) would raise `NameError: name 'data' is not defined`, be caught, and be surfaced to the client as 500 'Email sending failed: name data is not defined'. The email would already have been sent by Resend AND the DB record & auto-note inserted (both happen before line 451), so users would experience 'ghost failures': email delivered but UI shows error → likely to trigger duplicate sends. Verified with in-process test that stubs resend.Emails.send.
Consider re-raising HTTPException in the attachment >10MB branch so the client actually sees 400 (see minor issue above).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/team.py:454 — the broad `except Exception` wrapping catches HTTPException too, converting the 400 (attachment too large) into 500. Add `except HTTPException: raise` before the generic handler.

routes/team.py:412 — reads the whole attachment into memory before size check. For large uploads this defeats the 10MB limit as the request is already buffered. Consider checking Content-Length header first or using UploadFile.spool_max_size.
TeamCRM.jsx:388 — the X remove button next to an uploaded attachment has no data-testid; add e.g. `data-testid="email-attachment-remove"` for future tests.
TeamCRM.jsx:166 — after successful send the code compares `attachName` variable that is a snapshot of state; if user changes attachment mid-send race conditions may confuse the note text (minor).
SIGNATURE_HTML_TEMPLATE is duplicated between /app/backend/routes/team.py and any admin email templates (if any). Consider a shared emails/templates.py.
routes/team.py send_lead_email doesn't validate MIME type of attachment — a malicious .exe with mislabelled Content-Type will be forwarded to Resend as-is. Consider allowlisting doc/pdf/image types.

rca of the issue: Bug: routes/team.py line 451 used `{data.subject}` in the log line but `data` no longer exists after refactoring the endpoint from `async def send_lead_email(..., data: EmailSend)` to `async def send_lead_email(..., subject: str = Form(...), body: str = Form(...), ...)`. Only manifests when RESEND_API_KEY is set (else the earlier 500 short-circuits execution). Reproduction: monkeypatch RESEND_API_KEY -> any string, POST multipart to /api/team/leads/{id}/email → 500 with detail 'Email sending failed: name data is not defined'. Fix: replaced `{data.subject}` with `{subject}` (the Form parameter). Verified with 11-test suite that all 5 fix scenarios (empty/whitespace/custom signature, div layout, attachment persistence, size limit, Dennis name, preview 500) now pass.
